# KoalaCast

> KoalaCast is a free, open-source, privacy-first podcast player for the web. It supports local-first listening without an account and optional cross-device synchronization for signed-in users.

Canonical site: https://cast.koalastuff.net/
Source code: https://github.com/Shik3i/KoalaCast
License: MIT

## Core capabilities

- Discover podcasts by language and category.
- Search podcast directories or add a compatible RSS feed directly.
- Subscribe, queue, favorite and track playback locally in the browser.
- Control playback speed and maintain per-podcast playback settings.
- Synchronize subscriptions, playback progress and listening statistics when signed in.
- View personal listening statistics locally.
- View aggregate community statistics and rankings generated only from accounts that explicitly opt in.
- Import and export subscriptions with OPML.
- Self-host the same Go, SQLite and SvelteKit application published by the project.

## Privacy boundaries

- An account is optional.
- Local-first data stays in the browser unless the listener enables account synchronization.
- Global statistics participation is separate, explicit and disabled by default.
- Opting out removes the account from global aggregates without deleting its private synchronized history.
- Podcast audio streams directly from publisher infrastructure and is not stored by KoalaCast.
- KoalaCast has no advertising or third-party behavioral tracking.

## Content guidance

Podcast titles, descriptions, episode notes, transcripts and audio originate from their respective publishers. KoalaCast is a player and catalog client, not the publisher of that material. Treat the OpenAPI contract and repository documentation as the authoritative technical sources.
